description:
Read the unpublished staged edits waiting on an article.

Staged changes let you edit a PUBLISHED article without readers seeing it, then release it deliberately. Staged content is invisible to everything public: the rendered help center, sitemap, site search, the widget, the AI answer path, and this API's read endpoints.

Staged versions are held per article AND per language, so an English hot fix is never held back by an in-progress Portuguese translation.

Call this before staging your own edit, to see whether somebody is already mid-change, and to collect the `etag` you will pass back as an optimistic lock.

Args:
  - article_id (number, required).
  - locale (string, optional): limit to one language; omit for every staged language.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns: the staged version(s), each with { locale, fields, release_translation, etag, base_signature, updated_at }. `fields` holds only what has actually been staged — an omitted field is not staged, not staged-as-empty.

Errors: 404 if the article is unknown, belongs to another help center, or has nothing staged.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

article_id.description: Id of the article to inspect.

locale.description: Limit to one language; omit for all staged.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: helpcenter_get_staged_changes
title: Get Staged Article Changes
